notes: The prompt says outright that the NPC is there for testing shooting, and Shooter's index and genre notes route a gun-testing place to the Aim Trainer preset: no opposing team, no route through, everything the player shoots at downrange of one firing line. range-directed is that shape, and a zig-zag trench parapet facing a target standing in front of it is a firing line with safe ground behind it. Dropped the preset's station-loadout because the author hands the player one specific weapon at spawn rather than a rack to swap from, and bent target-practice to the single test NPC downrange. With no user to ask, I read the answers as a short WWI earthwork test stretch on one level, so nothing overhangs and the build stays on P0.
